name: Shealtiel (father of Zerubbabel)
title: Davidic heir in exile
summary: Shealtiel was a descendant of King David through King Jeconiah (Jehoiachin). He lived during the Babylonian exile and is best known as the father of Zerubbabel, who led the first return to Judah and the rebuilding of the temple.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's lineage
keyEvents.description: Shealtiel is mentioned as the son of Jeconiah (Jehoiachin) in the genealogies of Chronicles, confirming his place in the royal Davidic line.

keyEvents.title: Father of Zerubbabel
keyEvents.description: Shealtiel is repeatedly identified as the father of Zerubbabel, the leader who brought the Jews back from Babylon.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Haggai's prophecy
keyEvents.description: The prophet Haggai consistently refers to Zerubbabel as 'son of Shealtiel,' underscoring the significance of the messianic line.

keyEvents.title: In Jesus' genealogy according to Matthew
keyEvents.description: Shealtiel is mentioned in Matthew's genealogy as a key link in the royal line from David to Jesus Christ.

keyEvents.title: In Jesus' genealogy according to Luke
keyEvents.description: Luke also includes Shealtiel in his genealogy, which traces back from Jesus through the line of Nathan.
